chat.tutorial: Press E, then the compass tab (Search Items) to obtain unlimited copies of acquired items.
chat.welcome.materials: Hi {recipient}! You can gather materials on my farm. To save a little development work (or, let's be honest, be a little lazy :<), not every block can be broken. I can't exactly recreate an entire Minecraft web port by hand, can I? :) As long as we have enough to make a cake, that's all we need, right? ^^
chat.welcome.recipes: I did include all the recipes you can make with the materials available here, though, so exploring a little longer might lead to some surprises! (For example, hoppers have absolutely nothing to do with cake, but we can get iron and wood - which means we can craft one!)
chat.welcome.features: I can't promise whether you'll find surprises or bugs, though. Or, as we like to call them, "features". (#^ ^#)
chat.welcome.commands: Time and weather change on the farm, so you can place some torches for light. I've also added a few commands I find useful, like /gamerule advance_time, /gamerule advance_weather, /time, /weather, and /tp for switching scenes, such as /tp home. And, of course, my favorite: /tick - although it might also be the least useful command here QWQ. Feel free to use them!
chat.welcome.catalogue: Remember: once you've unlocked an item, you can get more of it whenever you want from the item catalogue in your inventory. You don't have to gather it again, though you're welcome to keep collecting if you enjoy it!
chat.welcome.shortcuts: I've tried to keep the controls implemented here consistent with Minecraft's original shortcuts, too. Try combining Shift, Ctrl, and mouse actions! Hopefully these familiar controls make crafting a little less tedious, without making you learn a whole new way to play.
chat.welcome.chat: Besides commands, you can also type messages in chat, just like in a regular game!
chat.welcome.scenes: If you need to switch scenes, open your inventory or pause to release the cursor, then click a scene button at the top of the page! Of course, you can also use the /tp command! Press F11 for fullscreen for a better experience; otherwise, the controls may conflict with browser shortcuts :>
